预言不可靠谱啊！！！（预言不可靠谱啊！！！（第22页）战神终于也明白了。他的嘴张得能塞进一整个战斧斧刃。“也就是说……那个被空间神主当宝贝一样塞给我们的传送阵，那个他说能召唤救世勇者的传送阵，最后召唤出来的是高阳？然后高阳杀完第一代魔王，又反过来把神界给灭了？这他妈算什么救世勇者？这明明是灭世魔头！”审判摇了摇头，伸手揉了揉眉心，声音里带着几分苦涩的自我纠正。“不，高阳确实救过世，只是他救完之后没有停手，预言只说被召唤的勇者可以拯救世界，没说救完之后会怎样，高阳在完成预言之后走向了预言的反面——但预言本身，确实实现了。”两位高高在上的神明怔怔地看着彼此，一时间都没有说话，空气中弥漫着难以言喻的沉默。可直到此刻，他们才明白那个关乎世界命运的预言背后，背负着多么厚重的沉重代价。他们最初的计划，是召唤来一个能从危机中拯救整个世界的勇者。可谁能想到，被召唤来的这个勇者，会在几千年的时光流逝之后，彻底转变身份。变成一个需要被新召唤来的另一个勇者诛杀的大魔王。这个世界重复了几十次勇者出手诛杀魔王的故事。一轮又一轮循环往复从未停止。可从来没有人想过，曾经拯救世界的勇者，其实是会一步步蜕变成毁灭秩序的魔王的。只要那个勇者存活的时间足够久，只要他心里放不下的执念足够重。山坡上安静了一会儿。两位神明还需要一段时间接受这个事实。殷血则是坐在草地上，还在掰着手指算她丢了多少钱，嘴里碎碎念着数字。而绵绵趴在她旁边，看着自己空空如也的空间戒指，时不时抽搭一下鼻子，从戒指边缘抠出一小撮饼干渣舔一口。一人一蛛显然完全没在听林默和审判刚才那段关于预言和命运的严肃讨论。林默倒也想得开。他将黑剑从地上拔起来挂回腰间，拍了拍袍角沾上的草屑，语气恢复了一贯的平淡。“行了。既然没有其他办法，咱们现在唯一能做的就是等，等黄昏层那边两个高阳打完了才能再做决定。不过那两个家伙都掌握时间法则，打多久没法预测，也许我们在这站半天那边就打完了，也许我们在这待到老死那边还没打完。”他扫了一眼周围这片原始而宁静的草地、小溪和远处炊烟袅袅的平原。“现在，先搞清楚咱们在哪。”

Chapter 474 Prophecy is unreliable (page 1)
Prophecy is unreliable! ! ! (Prophecy is unreliable!!! (Page 22)) The God of War finally understood. His mouth was open enough to fit a whole tomahawk blade. "In other words... that teleportation array that was given to us by the Lord of Space as a treasure, that teleportation array that he said could summon a savior hero, was Gao Yang the last person summoned? And then Gao Yang killed the first generation of demons. King, in turn, destroyed the world of gods? What the hell kind of hero is this? This is obviously the world-destroying devil!" Judgment shook his head, rubbed his eyebrows, and corrected himself with a hint of bitterness. "No, Gao Yang did save the world, but he didn't stop after saving it. The prophecy only said that the summoned hero could save the world, but it didn't say that he had finished saving the world. What will happen next? After Gao Yang completed the prophecy, he went to the opposite side of the prophecy - but the prophecy itself did come true. "The two aloof gods looked at each other blankly, without speaking for a while, and there was an unspeakable silence in the air. But it was not until this moment that they understood that there were many burdens behind the prophecy about the fate of the world. Such a heavy price. Their original plan was to summon a hero who could save the entire world from the crisis. But who would have thought that after thousands of years, the summoned hero would completely change his identity and become a great demon who needed to be killed by another newly summoned hero. The story of a brave man slaying the demon king goes on and on. But no one ever thought that the brave man who once saved the world would actually transform into the demon king who destroyed the world. As long as the brave man survived long enough, the two gods were quiet for a while. Ming still needs some time to accept this fact. Yin Xue is sitting on the grass, counting how much money she has lost, while Mianmian is lying next to her, looking at her empty space ring, twitching her nose from time to time, picking out a handful of cookie crumbs from the edge of the ring and licking it. Listening to the serious discussion between Lin Mo and Judgment about prophecy and destiny, Lin Mo was able to think about it. He picked up the black sword from the ground and hung it back on his waist. He patted the grass clippings on the corner of his robe and returned to his usual calm tone. "Okay. Since there is no other way, the only thing we can do now is to wait until the two Gao Yang on the dusk layer finish fighting. You can make a decision again. But those two guys have mastered the law of time, and it is impossible to predict how long they will fight. Maybe we will finish fighting there after half a day, or maybe we will not finish fighting there until we die." He glanced at the surrounding pristine and quiet grassland, the creek, and the smoke-filled plains in the distance. "Now, let's figure out where we are."
